# EverydayCalc

> Free US calculators for work, pay and health. Each page has a calculator, the formula, worked examples, FAQs and links to official sources (DOL, IRS, SSA, CDC).

## Calculators
- [Work Hours Calculator](https://muddasirriaz099.github.io/everydaycalc/work-hours-calculator.html): Daily and weekly hours with breaks, night shifts, overtime and pay.
- [Time Card Calculator](https://muddasirriaz099.github.io/everydaycalc/time-card-calculator.html): Weekly timesheet with lunch breaks: total hours, overtime and pay.
- [Overtime Calculator](https://muddasirriaz099.github.io/everydaycalc/overtime-calculator.html): Time-and-a-half and double-time pay, with federal and California daily rules.
- [BMI Calculator](https://muddasirriaz099.github.io/everydaycalc/bmi-calculator.html): BMI in feet, inches and pounds or cm and kg, with your healthy weight range.
- [Paycheck Calculator](https://muddasirriaz099.github.io/everydaycalc/paycheck-calculator.html): Estimate take-home pay after federal tax, state tax, FICA and deductions.
